PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: fx-divine-light-rays
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Atmosphere/VFX guard: transfer only light falloff, particle behavior, haze density, ember/gold color relationships, and cinematic exposure. Keep the effect content and compositing requirements controlled by this row.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain; explicitly requested golden luminous-VFX behavior only.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
FX-DIVINE-LIGHT-RAYS — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: CINEMATIC VFX, PARTICLES, LIGHT, TRANSFORMATION, AND MOTION REFERENCE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Cinematic production reference for the signature divine light rays of JESUS: THE HARROWING OF HELL—pure volumetric god rays as a physical atmosphere effect, not a character portrait and not a full narrative wide shot. The subject is light itself: thick, tangible shafts of ethereal golden radiance streaming downward through a vertical wound in the earth, the same descending shaft that opens from the desert night into Hell’s fortress. Color temperature reads as pure divine intrusion at approximately 6500K, keyed with ethereal gold (#FFD700), warm amber (#FFBF00), and cores of pure white radiance (#FFFFFF) that feel older than sunlight, never harsh electric white and never cold blue. These are living beams—dense enough to read as solid columns of illumination where they cut the dark, yet soft at the edges where they bloom into haze.

The environment is the upper approach of Hell’s descent shaft and the air above Hell’s gate: obsidian-black stone walls veined with dying embers, a cathedral ceiling of hanging smoke, and residual cold blue torch spill (~2000K, #4169E1) still clinging to the far edges of the frame so the divine gold can push it back. Deep crimson underglow and absolute obsidian blacks (#0A0A0A, #8B0000) survive only in the corners the light has not yet claimed. The rays enter from above as if heaven itself is pouring through the fissure, then fan and re-converge as they travel down the shaft, catching every suspended particle in their path.

Particulate atmosphere is essential to the effect. Fine ash, black dust, and microscopic smoke motes hang in still air, then ignite into visible paths where each beam passes—millions of tiny bright points creating crisp volumetric shafts with soft penumbras. Smoke layers drift slowly; some beams punch clean tunnels through denser fog; others fray into lace-like filaments where turbulence breaks them. Secondary bounce: warm amber spill painting the nearest black stone faces and bone-iron gate surfaces with a thin golden sheen, while farther architecture remains in cold blue shadow. Where beams strike iron-and-bone structure or floor grit, small specular glints and soft pools of amber light form, reinforcing physical coherence.

Composition prioritizes the FX as hero: strong vertical architecture of light, 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen framing, roughly 24–35mm wide enough to feel monumental yet close enough that individual ray edges, particle streaks, and smoke density remain readable. Slight low-angle or slightly tilted looking up the shaft emphasizes descent of power; optional three-quarter view across the fortress interior shows the same golden flood pouring through a breached gate opening after the shattering, burning shadows away and exposing every dark corner. Depth of field holds the mid-volume of rays sharp while distant smoke softens. Lens language is anamorphic epic without modern camera branding—gentle horizontal bloom on the brightest cores, natural volumetric scatter, no lens flares shaped like sci-fi hardware.

Continuity locks for the production: this is the same light that announces Jesus’ descent before the Guardians turn, the same radiance that makes shadows flee like rats, and the same blinding golden flood that pours through the shattered gate and later feeds the staircase of light and the transformation of black stone toward white marble and blue flame toward golden fire. Keep Hell torches blue only at the unclaimed periphery; divine beams always gold-amber-white. No modern objects, no power fixtures, no laser look, no neon, no UI, no readable text, logos, watermarks, captions, or borders. Photoreal live-action biblical epic VFX plate quality—reverent, physically plausible volumetric light in a supernatural place, never cartoon CGI, never illustration. Repeat for lock: ethereal gold and pure white god rays at ~6500K, warm amber particulate glow, cold blue residual hell-edge, ash and dust making every shaft visible, vertical shaft and fortress air as carrier of the divine intrusion.
